$comment: PROVENANCE, NOT A COUNT. The plan's original acceptance asked for nine fixture files and would have been satisfied by nine empty ones; a C0 review replaced that with this manifest, in which every entry must name the incident it came from, the layer expected to catch it, and what the old and new stacks are expected to do. An entry that could not be grounded is EXCLUDED with a reason and stays visible — D3 forbids inventing the detail instead.
grounding_method: each entry was checked against docs/plans/2026-06-29-BACKLOG.md and against .aid-o/work/evidence/ at this HEAD; an entry with neither is excluded

fixtures.$comment: expected_new is NOT `caught`: IMP-201 is deliberately on observe-hold (Step 3), so C4 sees the class and does not block on it. A fixture claiming `caught` here would be calibrating against a promotion that was refused.
the one entry whose catch is PROVEN by this step rather than deferred to the calibration run: the Step 1 preflight owns this class and can be run against the fixture directly.

the control that makes the others mean something. Without a case the stack must NOT flag, 'it caught everything' is satisfied by a stack that blocks unconditionally. Synthetic on purpose and labelled synthetic — this one is not claiming to be an incident.
